fields.description: The opaque docname series. Neither the recipient nor the announcement goes in the primary key, so a person's address is not derivable from a docname somebody saw.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Whose copy this is. The login, because a notification is something a person opens when they sign in, and somebody with no login has nowhere to open it. Resolved from the recipient's Red Profile at fan-out time and never from an address typed anywhere.
fields.label: Recipient

fields.description: Which announcement this is a copy of. The wording lives there and is read through this link rather than copied here: an announcement corrected after it went out is corrected for everybody, and a thousand copies of a paragraph are a thousand chances for the correction to miss one.
fields.label: Announcement

fields.description: When this copy was created. Distinct from the announcement's own published_on, because somebody who joins a branch after an announcement went out is not retrospectively sent it, and this is the field that says so.
fields.label: Delivered On

fields.description: Whether the recipient has read it. The only field on this record that anybody but the fan-out writes, and the only thing a recipient may change about their own copy.
fields.label: Read

fields.description: When they read it. Kept alongside the flag rather than derived from it, so a society asking whether an urgent advisory actually reached people has an answer with a time on it.
fields.label: Read On
